description: After the new tab is added, every pre-existing tab must be byte-identical in sheetId, title, index and grid size.
why_it_exists: addSheet without an explicit index can renumber sibling tabs, and a mistyped batchUpdate can resize or rename one. The harness fingerprints each tab as sheetId|title|index|rows|cols before and after and compares the sorted lists.
assertions: The set of sheetId|title|index|rows|cols fingerprints for all non-ConflictNotices tabs is identical before and after.
Exactly one tab named ConflictNotices exists after the run.
A changed index, a renamed tab or a resized grid on any pre-existing tab fails the run even if the new tab itself is perfect.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
